name: travel-agent
description: Daily toolkit for freelance travel agents working in Excel, Word and PDF, in English and Spanish: FTA, the Freelance Travel AI Agent that takes a request from client lookup to a priced quote, with MinnieAI (Walt Disney World) and FionaAI (Universal Orlando) specialists and Patty, the park planner; plus social content, destination research, client questionnaires, trip folders and Trip Sheets, voucher lookup, trip summaries, skills that learn from your feedback, an interactive dashboard of dates and pending tasks, and commission tracking. / Kit diario para agentes de viajes freelance en Excel, Word y PDF, en inglés y español.
